Role & responsibilities

Position

Agentic & Generative AI Engineer

Role Summary

The Agentic & Generative AI Engineer is responsible for designing, developing, and deploying intelligent AI agents and Generative AI solutions that automate reasoning, decision-making, analytics, and workflow orchestration. The role involves building autonomous AI systems, integrating them with enterprise data sources, and enabling natural-language interactions through Large Language Models (LLMs) and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) frameworks.

Key Responsibilities

1. AI Agent Development

Design and develop agentic AI systems using frameworks such as LangChain, AutoGen, Semantic Kernel, Haystack, and LlamaIndex.
Build multi-agent architectures with planning, reasoning, memory, tool usage, and feedback mechanisms.
Implement autonomous workflows for analytics, operations, customer support, and productivity automation.

2. Generative AI Solutions

Develop LLM-powered applications including:
Natural Language Querying
Summarization and Explanation Engines
Scenario Simulations and Calculators
Insight Generation and Anomaly Detection
Conversational AI Interfaces
Optimize and fine-tune models for domain-specific use cases.

3. Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG)

Build enterprise-grade RAG pipelines for document and knowledge retrieval.
Implement embeddings, vector databases, chunking strategies, prompt templates, and ranking mechanisms.

4. AI Tool Integration

Integrate AI agents with:
Databases
ERP/CRM Systems
Power BI and Anaplan
REST APIs
Python Tools and Business Workflows
Develop function-calling capabilities for real-time actions.

5. MLOps & AIOps

Deploy AI solutions on Azure ML, AWS SageMaker, Vertex AI, or on-premises environments.
Establish monitoring, guardrails, evaluation frameworks, and CI/CD pipelines for AI applications.

6. Collaboration & Solution Design

Collaborate with product, analytics, and engineering teams.
Design scalable, secure, and governed AI architectures.
Prepare technical documentation and architecture diagrams.

Required Technical Skills

Generative AI & LLMs

GPT, Llama, Mistral, Claude, Gemini
Prompt Engineering and Prompt Chaining
Transformers, Attention Mechanisms, and Embeddings
Open-source and proprietary LLM experience

Agentic AI

LangChain Agents
AutoGen / AutoGen Studio
Semantic Kernel
Multi-Agent Orchestration
Planning, Reflection, Memory Systems

RAG Engineering

FAISS, Pinecone, Milvus, Azure AI Search
Hybrid Search and Re-ranking
Retrieval Chains and Prompt Routing

Programming

Python (Mandatory)
FastAPI / Flask
TypeScript / JavaScript (Preferred)

Cloud & Deployment

Azure AI Studio
AWS Bedrock
Google Vertex AI
Docker & Kubernetes
DevOps and MLOps Practices

Data & Analytics

SQL and Data Modeling
APIs for Power BI, Dataverse, Anaplan, SAP
Basic Machine Learning Concepts

Soft Skills

Strong Problem-Solving Skills
System Design Thinking
Excellent Communication and Documentation
Stakeholder Management
Curiosity and Continuous Learning
Ownership and Ability to Work in Ambiguous Environments

Preferred Qualifications

B.Tech, M.Tech, MS in Computer Science, AI/ML, Data Science, or related fields
Azure AI, OpenAI, or Cloud Certifications
Experience building production-grade AI applications
Background in Analytics, Data Engineering, or ML Engineering
